description:
Build the mandatory "legal guarantees" box for terms of sale of goods sold to consumers in France: the official text of
    the French Consumer Code template (annex to art. D. 211-2, model A), with the seller's details, as HTML and plain text.
    Valid for the sale of goods only (pets and digital content or services have other templates).

    Args:
        seller_name: name of the seller who answers for the guarantees.
        seller_postal_address: postal address.
        seller_phone: phone number.
        seller_email: e-mail address or another digital contact.
name: generate_legal_guarantee_box
